description: This file contains a suite of UI view hierarchy smoke tests written in Swift, primarily for testing various SwiftUI views in the OpenClaw project. It uses test annotations to verify that each view builds and constructs correctly within a UIWindow environment.

methods.name: host
methods.description: Creates a UIWindow, sets up the provided SwiftUI view as the root view controller, makes the window key and visible, and performs layout updates.

methods.name: statusPillConnectingBuildsAViewHierarchy
methods.description: Tests that the 'StatusPill' view with 'connecting' gateway builds correctly within a UIWindow.

methods.name: statusPillDisconnectedBuildsAViewHierarchy
methods.description: Tests that the 'StatusPill' view with 'disconnected' gateway builds correctly within a UIWindow.

methods.name: settingsTabBuildsAViewHierarchy
methods.description: Verifies that the 'SettingsTab' view hierarchy constructs correctly with environment objects.

methods.name: rootTabsBuildAViewHierarchy
methods.description: Ensures that the 'RootTabs' view hierarchy builds properly with environment objects.

methods.name: voiceTabBuildsAViewHierarchy
methods.description: Checks the construction of the 'VoiceTab' view hierarchy within a UIWindow.

methods.name: voiceWakeWordsViewBuildsAViewHierarchy
methods.description: Verifies that 'VoiceWakeWordsSettingsView' builds within a SwiftUI NavigationStack.

methods.name: chatSheetBuildsAViewHierarchy
methods.description: Tests the 'ChatSheet' view with environment objects in a UIWindow context.

methods.name: voiceWakeToastBuildsAViewHierarchy
methods.description: Checks that the 'VoiceWakeToast' view builds correctly.
